title: The Shadow of the Wind
author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón
summary: In Barcelona after the Spanish Civil War, a boy is taken to a secret library of forgotten books and chooses one by an obscure author. He discovers that someone is burning every copy of that writer's work.
readIf: you love gothic, bookish mysteries with a city as vivid as any character.
skipIf: you dislike heavy melodrama or long, tangled backstories.

pairings.reason: Another dreamlike tale of hidden libraries and a reader who finds himself part of a story.
A moody, literary mystery of obsession and a death within a closed circle.
A more learned, medieval version of a murder mystery set around a library.
